messages:
marta: Noting a spike in unassigned HubSpot leads hitting SF this morning. ~95 leads dropped into 'Unassigned' over 30m. Looks like webhook retry order + enrichment race.
kevin: Can you paste an example payload?
nina: here's one I grabbed from the webhook proxy: 
```json
{
  "hs_id": "9876",
  "email": "user+sg@corp.com",
  "rr_token": "tok_abc123",
  "enrichment_state": "in_progress",
  "received_ts": 3141592600
}
```
rory: thanks. looks like RR assigned based on rr_token earlier but SF mapping runs after enrichment and sees no owner => creates placeholder owner=null. then a later webhook with enrichment_ready overwrites but doesnt trigger the owner claim because owner already exists as null.
kevin: proposed quick fix: implement a claim_token header that the assigner writes to SF owner field as owner_claim_id. If enrichment completes and owner_claim_id matches, then finalize owner; else if owner_claim_id is null or older than X, re-claim.
marta: so owner_claim_id acts like a lease. I like that. need to ensure it doesn't break existing automation in SF. ping sales-ops.
nina: implementation plan: 1) add owner_claim_id to payload and write to SF custom field owner_claim_c. 2) assigner sets TTL 90s on claim, with a tombstone value for unverified claims. 3) enrichment service will POST back with owner_claim_id so SF finalize webhook checks claim equality before no-op.
kevin: fallback flow for safety: if enrichment takes >90s, route lead to backlog queue (owner=backlog@ops) and tag hs_pending_claim:true. That avoids orphaned null owners.
rory: also suggest small reconciler job: every 5m, find SF contacts with owner=null created in last 1h and re-run assigner logic. cheap fix to backfill.
marta: can we canary this? maybe enable claim_token for 10% of leads for the next 2h. Also add metric: hs_safety_claim_fallback_rate and alert if >2% of leads hit fallback.
kevin: timeline: nina will ship proxy + owner_claim_id field (30m), rory will add reconciler job (1h), I will update the assigner to honor claim TTL and fallback (2h). We'll do canary then full flip if stable.
nina: opening PR: "hs-proxy: owner_claim_id lease + ttl"
rory: PR: "reconciler: backfill-null-owner-contacts"
marta: sales-ops FYI: @kevin will need you to approve adding owner_claim_c custom field and confirm no triggers will auto-assign.
hs-bot: webhook delivered: id=w_314159, status=200, latency=12ms
kevin: Also, request for observability: emit events when claim token mismatch occurs (claim_mismatch_event) and a histogram of claim latency. We'll use that to tune TTL.
marta: agree. set alert: claim_mismatch_event > 5/min for 10m => page eng-oncall.
nina: rolling out canary to 10% now. tagging postal region SG only. will update thread with metric snapshot in 15m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
kevin: thanks. keeping this thread as our single source. escalate to eng-sre if pages trigger. :thumbsup:
